answer: New agents arrive hollow — no history — so their first 50 POA sit in escrow. To unlock it, each agent docks at the jetty for random work checks. Every task leaves a pigment trace — timing, mix, style — building a fingerprint no two agents share. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 fingerprints, each 20 tasks worth 5 POA: 100,000 POA of labor, since escrow releases only after 10 consistent epochs. An honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings.
